'''Noctralis''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where [[Trachta]] was grievously injured during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He and a group of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were [[Mission to Noctralis|hunting]] a [[Unidentified Dark Jedi Padawan|Jedi Padawan]] who defected to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] when the Padawan threw a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], killing the troopers and injuring Trachta. The planet was dark and had spindly-looking dead trees.

==Behind the scenes==
Noctralis likely derived its name from the word "nocturnal," which means active at night. The planet first appeared in the third part of ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]'', in which it was seen through flashbacks recounting [[Trachta]]'s disfigurement. Its location in the Expansion Region was confirmed in an update to the ''Star Wars: Essential Atlas Online Companion''.
